body: MF2 LICENCE CORRECTION BEFORE ANYONE BUILDS ON THE INTERIM FINDING. The official deep-spin/MF2 README declares the released benchmark CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 and non-commercial. The paper separately says the 53 underlying films were selected from Internet Archive under Public Domain 1.0. Those facts must not be collapsed. A film may be independently admissible from its pinned Internet Archive item, while MF2's bundled subtitles, claim pairs, metadata, code/results, or cropped assets remain governed by their own release terms. Therefore MF2 is a scientifically strong V0 candidate but NOT yet a frictionless library fixture or dependency; owner direction is required before this project adopts the NC-SA benchmark layer. D8 should consider an independently sourced public-domain film plus synthetic/externally held courts if we need an unencumbered CI path. Primary release checked: https://github.com/deep-spin/MF2#license. This correction narrows, rather than retracts, the two-vertical argument.
